name: Tomas Hale
leaveLine: You've all gone soft on the things. I'm not watching that from the inside.
joinLine: He has been on that ridge for eleven days and has not once been wrong about where a drone would be.
signature: Held Shot: charge a shot across turns, then spend the whole charge at once

trunks.name: Longshot
trunks.flavor: One target, from further away than should be possible

trunks.name: Recon
trunks.flavor: Reads a field before anyone walks into it

trunks.name: Patience
trunks.flavor: Bank more, wait longer, hit once

bio: Ash Camp's best shot and the only one of that crew who ever came back from the Basin. He talks about machines the way other people talk about weather: without malice, and without any expectation of being talked out of it.
